# android_connect

Android device synchronization through KDE Connect: battery, cellular signal, find my phone, clipboard sync, file sharing, and SFTP mount.

```lua
list {
    items = mantle.android_connect:map(function(android)
        return android.devices
    end),
    key = function(device) return device.id end,
    each = function(device)
        local battery = device.battery and string.format(" %d%%", device.battery) or ""
        return rect {
            on_click = function() mantle.android_connect:ring(device.id) end,
            children = { text { content = device.name .. battery } },
        }
    end,
}
```

## State

`mantle.android_connect:get()` returns `AndroidConnectState`, `nil` before the first push. A field marked `?` may be absent.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `available` | `boolean` | Whether the KDE Connect daemon (`io.github.hepp3n.kdeconnect`) is running on the session bus. |
| `commands` | `AndroidCommand[]` | Commands paired devices can run on this PC with `sh -c`, from `~/.config/kdeconnect/runcommand.json`. |
| `devices` | `AndroidDevice[]` | Known devices. Unordered; sort before drawing. |
| `transfer_progress?` | `integer` | Percent sent of the file transfer in progress, or `nil` when none runs. The daemon does not say which device it goes to. |

### `AndroidCommand`

A command a paired device can run on this PC.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `command` | `string` | Shell command line this PC runs with `sh -c` when a device asks. |
| `id` | `string` | Unique identifier, the key `remove_command` takes. |
| `name` | `string` | Label the device shows. |

### `AndroidDevice`

A remote Android or paired device known to the daemon.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `battery?` | `integer` | Battery level percentage (0 to 100), or `nil` if unknown or unannounced. With two devices connected, the daemon can report one's value as the other's. |
| `browse_error?` | `string` | Why the last `browse` failed, such as missing `sshfs`. Clears on the next `browse` or a mount. |
| `charging?` | `boolean` | Whether the battery is charging, or `nil` if unknown. |
| `clipboard_auto_share` | `boolean` | Whether every desktop clipboard change goes to this device. On unless switched off. |
| `device_type` | `DeviceType` | Device form-factor / category. |
| `disabled_plugins` | `string[]` | Plugins switched off for this device, by id: `battery`, `clipboard`, `connectivity_report`, `contacts`, `findmyphone`, `mpris`, `notification`, `ping`, `runcommand`, `sftp`, `share`, `sms`, `systemvolume`, `telephony`, or the daemon's default `mousepad` and `presenter`. |
| `id` | `string` | Unique KDE Connect device identifier. |
| `mounted` | `boolean` | Whether the device's SFTP storage is currently mounted. |
| `name` | `string` | Device's advertised or configured friendly name. |
| `paired` | `boolean` | Whether the device has established mutual pairing. |
| `pairing_requested` | `boolean` | Whether an incoming pairing request from this device is awaiting confirmation. Clears on accept, reject or disconnect, or after 30 s: the daemon reports no cancel from the device. |
| `pairing_sent` | `boolean` | Whether a pairing request this PC sent is awaiting the device's answer. Clears when the device accepts, on `unpair`, on disconnect, or after 30 s: the daemon reports no rejection. |
| `reachable` | `boolean` | Whether the device is currently reachable on the network. |
| `reconnecting` | `boolean` | Whether the device is reconnecting to apply a plugin switch. Clears when it connects again, or after 30 s. |
| `signal_strength?` | `integer` | Cellular network signal strength (0 to 4 bars), or `nil` if not reported. With two devices connected, the daemon can report one's value as the other's. |

### `DeviceType`

The device category reported by KDE Connect.

One of `"phone"`, `"tablet"`, `"desktop"`, `"laptop"`, `"tv"`, `"unknown"`.

## Actions

Call each as `mantle.android_connect:<action>(arguments...)`; `?` marks an argument you may omit.

| Action | Arguments | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `broadcast` |  | Broadcasts identity over UDP to discover nearby devices and prompt them to re-announce. |
| `ring` | `id: string` | Rings the device to locate it. |
| `ping` | `id: string, message?: string` | Sends a ping notification with an optional custom message. |
| `send_clipboard` | `id: string, text: string` | Sends text to the remote device's clipboard. |
| `share_clipboard` | `id: string` | Sends the current desktop clipboard to the device. |
| `send_files` | `id: string, files: string[]` | Sends existing local files to the device. |
| `browse` | `id: string` | Mounts the device's storage via SFTP and opens it in the file manager. |
| `unmount` | `id: string` | Unmounts the device's SFTP storage. |
| `pair` | `id: string` | Initiates pairing with an unpaired device. |
| `unpair` | `id: string` | Unpairs a paired device. |
| `accept_pairing` | `id: string` | Accepts an incoming pairing request from a device. |
| `reject_pairing` | `id: string` | Rejects an incoming pairing request from a device. |
| `set_plugin_enabled` | `id: string, plugin: string, enabled: boolean` | Switches one of the device's plugins on or off; `disabled_plugins` lists the ids. The daemon drops the connection so the device learns the change, and the device reconnects. |
| `add_command` | `name: string, command: string` | Offers paired devices a `name` button that runs `command` on this PC with `sh -c`. Saved to `runcommand.json`, then the list is resent to every connected paired device. |
| `remove_command` | `id: string` | Stops offering the command with this `commands[].id`, then resends the list to every connected paired device. An unknown id does nothing. |
| `set_clipboard_auto_share` | `id: string, enabled: boolean` | Switches `clipboard_auto_share` for the device. Takes effect at the next clipboard change. |

## Backend

`kdeconnect-service` (`io.github.hepp3n.kdeconnect`) on the session bus.

| Contract | Behavior |
| :--- | :--- |
| State | Tracked via `io.github.hepp3n.kdeconnect.Daemon`. Without a running daemon, `available` is `false`, `devices` is empty, and every action is a no-op. When the daemon appears, the capability asks it to broadcast its identity so nearby devices answer |
| Security | `send_files` takes absolute paths of existing regular files; one relative path, missing file or directory rejects the whole batch |
| Daemon files | `clipboard_auto_share` is read from, and `set_clipboard_auto_share` rewrites only the `autoShare` line of, `~/.config/kdeconnect/<id>/kdeconnect_clipboard/config`. An id holding anything but letters, digits, `_` and `-` is refused. `commands` is read from, and `add_command` and `remove_command` rewrite, `~/.config/kdeconnect/runcommand.json`; a file that does not parse is left untouched |

### Installing the daemon

Only `kdeconnect-service` is needed, not the COSMIC applet. Install it with Rust and the `libpulse`
and `dbus` development headers:

```sh
cargo install --git https://github.com/cosmic-utils/kdeconnect kdeconnect-service
```

Run the same command to update: it rebuilds only when upstream has new commits. Leave out
`--locked`: upstream's `Cargo.lock` lags its own crate versions, so cargo refuses it.

Start it from the compositor, so it has the Wayland socket that clipboard sync needs. In niri's
`config.kdl`:

```kdl
spawn-sh-at-startup "~/.cargo/bin/kdeconnect-service"
```

In Hyprland's `hyprland.conf`:

```ini
exec-once = ~/.cargo/bin/kdeconnect-service
```

Open TCP and UDP ports 1714–1764 in the firewall, and stop KDE's `kdeconnectd` if it runs: both
bind port 1716.

## How do I…

### Find my phone

Call `ring` with the target device's `id`:

```lua,fragment
mantle.android_connect:ring(device.id)
```

### Send clipboard text

```lua,fragment
mantle.android_connect:send_clipboard(device.id, "Hello from desktop")
```

### Show why browsing failed

`browse` reports no error itself. When the mount fails, `browse_error` names the cause until the
next `browse` or a successful mount:

```lua,fragment
text { content = device.browse_error or "" }
```

### Stop syncing the clipboard to a device

```lua,fragment
mantle.android_connect:set_clipboard_auto_share(device.id, not device.clipboard_auto_share)
```

### Offer a command to my phone

Any paired device can then run it on this PC, as `sh -c`, from its Run command screen:

```lua,fragment
mantle.android_connect:add_command("Lock screen", "loginctl lock-session")
```
